subject.title: Skill steipete/bird: Homebrew formula download URL 404 (bird-macos-universal-v0.8.0.tar.gz)

question: Should the old @steipete/bird skill stay hidden/deprecated, be republished with a fixed upstream, or be aliased/replaced by Birdclaw?
rationale: Current main has no Bird payload to patch, the original upstream is still unavailable, and choosing Birdclaw or an old-slug status changes production catalog semantics.

options.title: Keep Hidden Or Deprecated
options.body: Keep the old slug unavailable until the owner confirms a replacement, and optionally add a clear deprecated/unavailable state if the skill record still exists in production.

options.title: Republish Fixed Bird Metadata
options.body: If the owner identifies a new canonical Bird repo or asset, update and republish the skill metadata to point at that source.

options.title: Alias To Birdclaw
options.body: If the owner confirms Birdclaw is the intended successor, update production metadata or routing so old Bird users land on the replacement intentionally.

recommendation.title: Keep Hidden Or Deprecated
recommendation.body: Keep the old slug unavailable until the owner confirms a replacement, and optionally add a clear deprecated/unavailable state if the skill record still exists in production.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice depends on the upstream namespace owner/admin confirming whether Birdclaw is the successor or the old Bird slug should remain unavailable.
